name: bannerai
description: Bannerai — AI banner studio for events, campaigns and promotions

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @bannerai/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @bannerai/shared && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @bannerai/shared && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bannerai/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @bannerai/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @bannerai/shared && npm run test -w apps/api --if-present && npm run test -w apps/web --if-present
